caption: The drawing depicts a simple, outlined chalice centered on a plain, off-white background. The chalice has a bell-shaped cup with slightly outward-flaring sides, a short stem, and a circular foot and base. There is a small rectangular label near the upper right shoulder of the chalice with the word "GARDNER" written in uppercase letters. Below the chalice, there is a handwritten inscription in two styles of script: “Given by Doctor YELDALL L 7 7s part. Towards making this CHALICE 1773,” with “YELDALL,” “CHALICE,” and “1773” in bold uppercase letters, and the rest in a cursive style. The symbol “L” is used to denote pounds and the "s" superscript suggests shillings, referencing currency. In the lower right corner, there is a signature written diagonally in cursive script, reading "Lawrence Flynn." The drawing is done entirely in black ink and is devoid of shading, with only simple line work used to define forms and text. There is a faint yellowish stain near the top center of the paper.
title: Silver Chalice
